text:
leah: Proposing RC-9777 for the maintenance window at 02:15 UTC. Required: artifact pin, release-notes snip pinned, KV warm, sheriff, and an explicit rollback runbook. Can someone own sheriff?
deploy-bot: RC-9777 created from `release/serve@c7d9e1`. Artifacts pinned: `serve-api:9777` (sha: 11aa22bb). Preflight available: `deploy-bot preflight --rc=9777 --kv-warm`.
omar: I can sheriff 02:00-03:00 UTC.
kai_oncall: There's a queued config change touching `cache_prefix`. Owner will hold until 03:30 UTC if we need it.
nina_release: I'll pin the release notes and add a short customer blurb. Also will run KV warm on staging now.
ops-runner: Suggested rollback snippet (manual):
```
# revert to known-good image
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/serve-api serve-api=redwood/serve-api:9760
# flip routing flag
curl -X POST https://config.internal/flags -d '{"use_v2_router":false}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $KMS_TOKEN"
```
leah: Good. Deploy bot, run preflight and attach smoke logs + KV warm summary. If preflight fails we delay promo.
deploy-bot: Preflight complete: KV warm (staging) 14/14 primed. Smoke: 2/2 ok (short-gen, routing-check). Health: p95 latency within 110% baseline. Logs: https://logs.redwood/rc9777/preflight (internal).
omar: I've updated the runbook with rollback URL https://wiki.redwood/ops/rc-9777-rollback and added the config-change owner hold.
leah: Plan for promo: 02:15 UTC -> canary 3% for 6m, 30% for 8m, then 100% if healthy. Auto-fallback to image 9760 if error rate >3% or spike in latency >40%.
nina_release: Notes pinned. Roles: Omar=sheriff, Leah=deploy lead, Kai=rollback exec, Nina=release notes. Any objections?
kai_oncall: I'll be ready to execute rollback if SLOs breach. Keep the traces dashboard open.
omar: All good from me.
leah: Great. I'll post an hour reminder and reconvene at 02:05 for final go/no-go. :white_check_mark:
